data.title: Winter Season Road Closures
data.description: The following roads have been closed for the winter season: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive (at Upper Lehman Creek Campground), Snake Creek Road, Strawberry Creek Road

data.title: No Potable Water in Park Campgrounds
data.description: There is no water available in any campground in Great Basin National Park.  Water is available at the Great Basin Visitor Center and the Lehman Caves Visitor Center.
